description_en: Adds a face image for a user in the face database
description_zh: 调用该接口，为人脸底库中的用户增加一张人脸图片
kebab_example: aliyun linkvisual add-face-user-picture --isolation-id ZheJiangHZ --user-id 3mtjaqebeq4d0000 --face-pic-url https://example.com/test.jpeg --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddFaceUserPicture

parameters.help_en: The business isolation ID, which is used to isolate data between different business applications under the same Alibaba Cloud account. Set this parameter to the same value as the **IsolationId** specified when you called the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/288338.html operation to add the user
parameters.help_zh: 业务隔离ID，用于隔离同一个阿里云账号下不同业务应用之间的数据。请与调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/288338.html接口添加用户时设置的**IsolationId**保持一致
parameters.name: isolation_id

parameters.help_en: The user ID. Set this parameter to the **UserId** value that you obtained and saved locally after calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/288338.html operation to add the user
parameters.help_zh: 用户ID。请传入在调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/288338.html接口添加用户后，获取并保存到本地的**UserId**值
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The URL download address of the face image. Only images in JPEG and JPG formats are supported. The image URL cannot contain Chinese characters
parameters.help_zh: 用户的人脸图片URL下载地址，当前仅支持JPEG和JPG格式的图片，且图片URL中不能包含中文
parameters.name: face_pic_url
